name: Tokyo
description: Neon districts and quiet shrines within one train ride of each other.

name: Kyoto
description: Temple gardens, tea houses and the old imperial street grid.

name: Osaka
description: Street food, castle grounds and the loudest nightlife in Kansai.

name: Seoul
description: Palaces, mountain trails and markets that stay open past midnight.

name: Bangkok
description: Canal boats, gilded temples and the best cheap food anywhere.

name: Chiang Mai
description: Old-city moat, mountain temples and a slow northern pace.

name: Hanoi
description: Lake walks, pavement kitchens and a very dense old quarter.

name: Bali
description: Rice terraces on one coast, surf breaks on the other.

name: Singapore
description: Hawker centres, engineered gardens and a very short taxi ride to everything.

name: Jaipur
description: Pink sandstone city walls, hill forts and block-print workshops.

name: Udaipur
description: Lake palaces, rooftop dinners and narrow lanes up to the city palace.

name: Goa
description: Portuguese churches inland, long beaches and shacks on the coast.

name: Kathmandu
description: Durbar squares, stupas and the staging point for every Himalayan trek.

name: Dubai
description: Desert on one side, a skyline of records on the other.

name: Istanbul
description: Two continents, one ferry ride, and a bazaar older than most countries.

name: Cairo
description: Pyramids on the edge of the suburbs and a museum you cannot finish in a day.

name: Marrakesh
description: Riad courtyards, a working medina and the Atlas mountains an hour away.

name: Cape Town
description: A flat-topped mountain in the middle of the city and wine country behind it.

name: Nairobi
description: A national park inside the city limits and the gateway to the Rift Valley.

name: Paris
description: Museums, market streets and long dinners that run past closing.

name: Nice
description: A pebble bay, an old town and easy trains along the Riviera.

name: Barcelona
description: Modernist facades, a city beach and dinner at ten.

name: Lisbon
description: Seven hills, tiled fronts and trams that take the corners badly.

name: Porto
description: River cellars, iron bridges and the cheapest good food in the west.

name: Rome
description: Ruins used as roundabouts and a fountain on every second corner.

name: Florence
description: A walkable Renaissance city with Tuscany at the end of the line.

name: Amsterdam
description: Canal rings, bike lanes and museums within a kilometre of each other.

name: Berlin
description: Cold-war history, cheap rent for a capital, and very late nights.

name: Vienna
description: Coffee houses, concert halls and a river you can swim in.

name: Prague
description: A stone bridge, a castle above it, and beer cheaper than water.

name: Budapest
description: Thermal baths, ruin bars and a parliament best seen from the far bank.

name: Kraków
description: An intact old square, a salt mine and difficult history nearby.

name: Reykjavík
description: A small capital with volcanoes, geysers and glaciers on a day loop.

name: Copenhagen
description: Harbour swimming, design shops and a bicycle for every resident.

name: Edinburgh
description: A castle on a plug of rock and closes running down either side.

name: London
description: Free museums, expensive everything else, and parks that go on for miles.

name: New York
description: Five boroughs, one subway, and a queue for every good thing.

name: San Francisco
description: Fog, hills, and a bridge that photographs itself.

name: Mexico City
description: Pyramids at the edge, markets in the middle, and the best tacos on earth.

name: Vancouver
description: Sea on one side, ski runs on the other, both reachable before lunch.

name: Rio de Janeiro
description: Beaches between granite peaks and a city that stays outdoors.

name: Buenos Aires
description: European avenues, steak dinners and tango after midnight.

name: Cusco
description: Inca walls under colonial arcades, and the trailhead for Machu Picchu.

name: Cartagena
description: A walled city on the Caribbean with islands a boat ride out.

name: Sydney
description: A working harbour, ocean pools and a coastal walk between beaches.

name: Queenstown
description: A lake town where every activity involves leaving solid ground.

name: Auckland
description: Volcano cones, two harbours and ferries to island vineyards.
